instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Anchor is a boutique event venue and catering provider specializing in high-end corporate conferences and intimate weddings. They manage multiple physical spaces, focusing heavily on seamless onsite execution for large events. The organization is focused on improving operational efficiency to handle increasing client volume while maintaining the premium service experience.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring to better target high-value corporate leads.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: The market is increasingly saturated with similar venue offerings. Anchor needs to strategically diversify into complementary hospitality services, such as specialized corporate retreats or experiential local tourism packages, to mitigate reliance on large annual conferences.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: End-to-end Event Management Platform Integration
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a fully integrated suite of event management software (CRM + floor plan + menu) will streamline day-of operations and reduce manual errors, directly addressing current integration inefficiencies.

first_actions: Conduct vendor selection for an all-in-one event tech solution.
Pilot the new CRM with the top 10% of sales leads.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in event setup/day-of operational errors by 25% within Q4.

opportunities.title: Diversification: Launch of Experiential Local Tourism Packages
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing venue capacity and catering skills, Anchor can enter the adjacent market of curated corporate wellness retreats or niche local tourism experiences. This creates a new revenue stream outside the core conference model.

first_actions: Identify 3 potential complementary service partners (e.g., boutique wineries/local artisans).
Develop a minimum viable 'Wellness Retreat' concept and pricing structure.
execution_plan.success_metric: Generate 15% of total annual revenue from new non-conference services by Year 2.

next_steps.action: Establish a formal, time-boxed 'Innovation Sprint' budget and mandate for the small leadership team.
Commission a comprehensive market analysis identifying three specific adjacent diversification targets.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formally ring-fenced innovation time/budget, leading to reactive rather than proactive development.
Low digital maturity (Level 2) resulting in ad-hoc system integrations that hinder scalable process automation.
Over-reliance on a concentrated customer base and single product category, posing significant diversification risk.
Small team size struggling to balance current operational maintenance with the necessary exploratory work for strategic growth.
